description: Integration test proving the full MTA-STS downgrade protection path. Setup: (1) start a mock outbound MTA (tokio TCP listener) that presents a normal SMTP greeting but deliberately omits STARTTLS from its EHLO response (simulating a STARTTLS-stripping attacker); (2) configure stoa with an MTA-STS cache entry for the test domain in 'enforce' mode with mx matching the mock MTA's hostname; (3) attempt delivery through stoa relay. Expected result: stoa detects TLS unavailable on an enforce-mode domain, rejects delivery, does NOT send the message body in plaintext. Also test: testing mode with same stripped STARTTLS — delivery proceeds, TLSRPT failure event recorded. This test must observe the mock MTA's received-bytes stream and assert the message DATA was never transmitted.
title: E2E: enforce mode blocks delivery when STARTTLS stripped
